text: ゲームで　ためた　コインは　そとの　こうかんじょで　すきな　けいひんと　かえてね！
note: This mirrors Japanese pachinko parlours, where winnings are swapped for prizes and the prizes are then traded for cash at a separate exchange window outside the parlour.
claim: In Japanese pachinko parlours, winnings are exchanged for prizes, which can then be traded for cash at a separate exchange place outside the parlour.

check.quote: Pachinko balls won from games cannot be exchanged directly for money in the parlor [...] However, they can be legally traded to the parlor for so-called 'special prize' tokens [...] that can be sold for cash at an outside establishment in the vicinity of the parlor.
check.note: This mirrors Japanese pachinko parlours, where winnings are swapped for prizes and the prizes are then traded for cash at a separate exchange window outside the parlour.
